cases.name: ieee754_subnormals
cases.prompt_text: Explain IEEE-754 floating point representation and subnormal numbers step by step, including sign, exponent, significand, bias, and gradual underflow.

cases.name: dijkstra_shortest_path
cases.prompt_text: Walk through Dijkstra shortest-path algorithm on a weighted graph. Explain the priority queue, distance initialization, relaxation, visited states, complexity, and why negative edge weights are invalid.

cases.name: posix_shm_tlb_shootdown
cases.prompt_text: Explain how Linux implements POSIX shared memory, how page tables map shm pages into processes, and why TLB shootdowns are required after unmapping. Include shm_open, mmap, page faults, huge pages, and multiprocessor invalidation. Discuss locking, cache coherency, IPI latency, memory ordering, and safe access across sockets.
